releaseNotes: 📱 Universal Responsive UI Scaling: Automatic proportional scaling across all Android screen sizes and display zoom levels.
🖼️ Refined Photo Grid & Media Vault: Balanced 3-column square photo tiles with compact non-overlapping badges and reorder controls.
⚡ Seamless Listing Cache & Switching: Fixed image cross-contamination when switching between My Listings and All Listings.
🔢 Contextual Listing Counters: Added clear filtered count display matching segment totals.
🌐 Full Bilingual Navigation: Seamless language switching across listing creation, editing, and review steps.
